race.description: Coolmore Denman Cup Day 5 October Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: BACKHANDER (6) failed to back up the good win two back with a battling fourth over 1400m at Mudgee on the soft (7) surface. Gets out in trip from the low gate and is expected to play a leading role. GEMTIKI (5) doesn't win out of turn but is holding her form this time in. Won over this track and trip four starts back when demolishing a Maiden field by a big space. Backs up quickly after catching the eye when second over 1600m at Taree. Best figures measure up nicely. SAMOAN ROMAN (8) improved sharply at his second race start when he ploughed through the heavy going to finish second over 1400m at Bathurst. Desperate to get out in trip and not to be underestimated. DAMASCUS GATE (1) has a good record here and is due for a change of luck today. Was a week between runs when taken to the front for a game third over 1600m at Taree. Hard fit and not to be underestimated.
